principals.name: A
principals.description: the initiator: chooses the session key, generates the timestamp T_a, and encrypts the first message with the long-term shared key K_as.

principals.name: B
principals.description: the recipient: decrypts the server's message with the long-term shared key K_bs and checks the freshness of S's timestamp T_s.

principals.name: S
principals.description: the trusted authentication server: decrypts and checks A's message with K_as, generates T_s, and encrypts the forwarded session-key message with K_bs.

values.name: K_as
values.description: K_as is a pre-run symmetric key or keying value.

values.name: K_bs
values.description: K_bs is a pre-run symmetric key or keying value.
